說明: 《千秋硯》卷二〈牧野〉生圖清單（回一～回四）。畫風、節點、尺寸沿用卷一清單。注意：人牲只畫等待與記憶，不畫過程；羌人圈只畫遠景與勞動，不畫暴力。

items.name: 南港陳列館
items.prompt: A quiet modern museum gallery in Taipei, Taiwan, softly lit glass display cases holding yellowish-brown ancient oracle bones and green bronze ritual vessels, polished stone floor, a wooden bench in the middle, calm afternoon light, no visitors in the foreground.

items.name: 洹水岸邊
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, Yellow River plain, a wide muddy yellow river bending slowly, tall reeds on the near bank; on the far side a flat loess plain with scattered low thatched houses on rammed-earth platforms; behind the houses, several thin wisps of dark smoke drift up from low open fires hidden on the ground, into a hazy sky; no towers, no chimneys, no stacks, nothing tall and vertical except the smoke; the riverbank is a natural sloping earth bank. Architecture as in Bronze Age archaeology reconstructions: single-storey rectangular halls of plain timber posts with walls of yellow rammed earth and wattle-and-daub, each under one thick, heavy, straight-sloped roof of dry straw thatch with a straight ridge and blunt, rounded, untrimmed edges, roofs low and simple like big haystacks; the settlement is open and unwalled, scattered across the flat plain.

items.name: 大邑商
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, Yellow River plain, the royal capital seen across a wide flat plain: dozens of long single-storey timber halls standing on low yellow rammed-earth platforms, spread out loosely with open ground between them, flat packed-earth roads, craftsmen carrying timber and pottery, thin smoke from open-air workshops, orderly and vast, warm ochre tones. Architecture as in Bronze Age archaeology reconstructions: single-storey rectangular halls of plain timber posts with walls of yellow rammed earth and wattle-and-daub, each under one thick, heavy, straight-sloped roof of dry straw thatch with a straight ridge and blunt, rounded, untrimmed edges, roofs low and simple like big haystacks; the settlement is open and unwalled, scattered across the flat plain.

items.name: 貞人之家
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, Yellow River plain, the packed-earth courtyard of a royal diviner's house, rows of cleaned ox shoulder blades and turtle plastrons drying on straw mats in the sun, a low wooden table under the thatched eaves with small bronze drills and knives, calm and orderly. Each ox shoulder blade is a flat, pale, smooth, roughly triangular plate of bone about the length of a forearm, cleaned of all flesh and hide, with no horns, no skull, no fur; each turtle plastron is a flat, pale, oval belly shell plate, empty, not a living turtle. Architecture as in Bronze Age archaeology reconstructions: single-storey rectangular halls of plain timber posts with walls of yellow rammed earth and wattle-and-daub, each under one thick, heavy, straight-sloped roof of dry straw thatch with a straight ridge and blunt, rounded, untrimmed edges, roofs low and simple like big haystacks.

items.name: 卜室
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, Yellow River plain, a windowless divination chamber with walls of rammed earth, lit only by charcoal glowing in a bronze basin at the center, walls glowing orange, a single ox shoulder blade laid lengthwise on a straw mat before the fire, deep shadows, solemn and tense. The ox shoulder blade is a broad, flat bone shaped like a wide paddle or a hand fan: at one end a short narrow neck with a rounded knob joint, quickly widening into a thin, flat, broad triangular blade as wide as a hand-span, about as long as a forearm, pale and smooth, cleaned of all flesh and hide; several small oval hollows scattered on its flat surface. It is not round, not a shell, no seams or plates, no horns, no skull.

items.name: 羌人圈
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, Yellow River plain, at a distance, a large open enclosure fenced with wooden stakes and ropes on the western edge of the city, many figures sitting quietly inside, some carrying baskets of earth toward a platform being built, somber dusk light, no violence, melancholic.

items.name: 甲骨窖穴
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, Yellow River plain, a deep rectangular storage pit dug into packed earth at night, smooth earthen walls, layers of stacked inscribed oracle bones and turtle shells, a torch casting flickering light, faint eerie grey glow among the bones.

items.name: 商邑市集
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, Yellow River plain, an open marketplace south of the temple, people trading painted pottery, millet, salt and turtle shells, strings of cowrie shells hanging at a stall, busy but gentle. Strictly Bronze Age: only steep thatched straw roofs on timber posts, no ceramic roof tiles, no upturned curved eaves, no pagodas, no city walls, no later imperial architecture.

items.name: 妌_14
items.prompt: A 14-year-old girl of the late Shang dynasty, black hair gathered in a simple bun held by a carved bone hairpin, plain undyed hemp tunic with a crossed collar and a cloth belt, bright curious eyes and a slightly stubborn mouth, a thin bronze carving knife tucked in her belt.

items.name: 十七
items.prompt: A 15-year-old boy from the western highlands, captive in the Shang capital, messy long black hair loosely tied, sun-darkened skin with a smudge of dirt, a worn sheepskin vest over a rough hemp shirt, a wide open grin showing one small pointed canine tooth, cheerful and warm despite hardship.

items.name: 箙
items.prompt: A gentle middle-aged royal diviner of the late Shang dynasty, calm lined face with deep crow's feet from years of close work, hair bound on top with a bronze pin, plain white hemp robe, patient steady eyes.

items.name: 裂兆
items.prompt: Floating burning cracks in the air shaped like the oracle crack sign, glowing orange edges, sparks and flakes of bone ash, like a heartbeat made of fire.

items.name: 骨蠹
items.prompt: A large pale grub-like insect made of bone fragments, chewing on an inscribed oracle bone, segmented body with faint carved marks being eaten away, dusty earth tones.

items.name: 洹水瘴
items.prompt: A heavy drifting mist rising from a muddy river, yellow-grey fog with reeds inside it, faint shapes of flooded houses within, cold and damp.

items.name: 銅鏽兵
items.prompt: The ghost of an ancient Shang palace guard holding a bronze dagger-axe covered in green patina, body half transparent, stiff and loyal, empty eyes.

items.name: 無字骨
items.prompt: A tall thin creature assembled from many blank ox shoulder blades whose inscriptions have been wiped clean, pale grey glow, reaching out with long bony hands, eerie and sorrowful.

items.name: 兆魘
items.prompt: A roaring fire in a bronze basin with many faint faces crowded inside the flames, old men, women and children all staring and waiting, dread rather than malice, dark red and ink black.

items.name: 讀兆
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, Yellow River plain, inside a dark divination chamber lit only by the warm orange glow of charcoal in a bronze fire basin, a middle-aged diviner kneels before an ox shoulder blade lying on a mat that has just cracked; a teenage girl kneels behind him holding with both hands a thin wooden branch whose tip is a small smouldering red-hot ember, glowing dull red and orange with a wisp of smoke, faint like a coal, not a flame, not a torch, giving almost no light; both stare at a single thin crack line on the bone; an old messenger in white hemp stands in the shadows. The ox shoulder blade is a flat, pale, smooth, roughly triangular plate of bone about the length of a forearm, cleaned of all flesh and hide, with no horns, no skull, no fur.

items.name: 路口
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, Yellow River plain, dawn at the western edge of the settlement, a teenage boy carrying a bamboo basket on his shoulder walks back toward a fence of wooden stakes, he turns his head and smiles, in the foreground a young man stands still at a crossroads of dirt paths, only low thatched huts far in the distance, long shadows, quiet heartbreak. Architecture as in Bronze Age archaeology reconstructions: single-storey rectangular halls of plain timber posts with walls of yellow rammed earth and wattle-and-daub, each under one thick, heavy, straight-sloped roof of dry straw thatch with a straight ridge and blunt, rounded, untrimmed edges, roofs low and simple like big haystacks; the settlement is open and unwalled, scattered across the flat plain.

items.name: 夯土台
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, a large rammed-earth platform under construction behind a temple, rows of laborers lifting heavy wooden tampers between wooden boards filled with yellow earth, dust in the air, overseers standing aside, a simple thatched timber hall in the distance, harsh midday light, no violence. Architecture as in Bronze Age archaeology reconstructions: single-storey rectangular halls of plain timber posts with walls of yellow rammed earth and wattle-and-daub, each under one thick, heavy, straight-sloped roof of dry straw thatch with a straight ridge and blunt, rounded, untrimmed edges, roofs low and simple like big haystacks; the settlement is open and unwalled, scattered across the flat plain.

items.name: 宗廟
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, a large ancestral temple hall: one long single-storey timber hall with a massive plain thatched roof, standing on a high, wide platform of yellow rammed earth with an earthen ramp leading up, a swept open earthen square in front, bronze ritual vessels glinting near the ramp, a column of smoke rising behind, open sky all around, solemn and imposing. Architecture as in Bronze Age archaeology reconstructions: single-storey rectangular halls of plain timber posts with walls of yellow rammed earth and wattle-and-daub, each under one thick, heavy, straight-sloped roof of dry straw thatch with a straight ridge and blunt, rounded, untrimmed edges, roofs low and simple like big haystacks; the settlement is open and unwalled, scattered across the flat plain.

items.name: 阿桑婆
items.prompt: An elderly hunched woman from the western highlands, deep wrinkles, gray hair loosely tied, calm knowing eyes, a worn sheepskin wrap over plain hemp clothes, holding a sleeping baby wrapped in cloth.

items.name: 夯土傀
items.prompt: A hulking golem made of layered rammed yellow earth with wooden tamper poles stuck in its back, dust falling from its body, heavy and tired, endlessly pounding.

items.name: 陶範魅
items.prompt: A floating cracked ceramic casting mold for bronze, molten orange bronze glowing and dripping from its seams, earthy reds and blacks.

items.name: 鴞影
items.prompt: A ghostly owl spirit shaped like an ancient Shang bronze owl vessel, green patina feathers, huge round glowing eyes, wings half spread, eerie and watchful.

items.name: 祭火
items.prompt: A towering bonfire that has burned for three days, flames shaped like a solemn tall figure, ash and sparks swirling, deep red and black, ominous rather than evil.

items.name: 饕餮之影
items.prompt: An enormous floating taotie mask from Shang bronzes come alive: huge staring eyes, curling horns, a vast open mouth with no body, green patina and dark bronze, devouring hunger, symmetrical.

items.name: 大祭之日
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, seen from the back of a crowd, a young man and a translucent ink-haired young woman stand at the edge of a wide earthen square holding hands; far away, a long single-storey timber temple hall with a massive plain thatched roof on a high rammed-earth platform, wooden drums, smoke rising behind the hall into a clear blue sky, the crowd ordinary and festive, no violence shown, quiet grief. Architecture as in Bronze Age archaeology reconstructions: single-storey rectangular halls of plain timber posts with walls of yellow rammed earth and wattle-and-daub, each under one thick, heavy, straight-sloped roof of dry straw thatch with a straight ridge and blunt, rounded, untrimmed edges, roofs low and simple like big haystacks; the settlement is open and unwalled, scattered across the flat plain.

items.name: 名字
items.prompt: Late Shang dynasty China around 1050 BC, night, a 15-year-old boy with a lean boyish face, messy long black hair loosely tied, a worn sheepskin vest over a rough hemp shirt, a sleeping baby held in his arms with its tiny hand gripping his shirt, leans against a fence of wooden stakes, whispering through the gap to a young man outside; the young man listens closely, holding a small closed notebook against his chest with both hands, the moonlight on them, tender and sad. The notebook is closed, no visible pages, no writing, no characters anywhere in the picture.

items.name: 周原
items.prompt: A vast windswept yellow loess plateau cut by deep gullies, fields of millet rippling like a yellow blanket, a long mountain range (Mount Qi) across the horizon, big sky, sheep on a distant slope, ancient China around 1048 BC.

items.name: 岐邑
items.prompt: Early Zhou people around 1048 BC on the loess plateau of the Wei River valley, a modest settlement of houses on low rammed-earth platforms, busy people in plain hemp clothes, two-wheeled wooden chariots training on an open field outside raising yellow dust. Architecture as in Bronze Age archaeology reconstructions: single-storey rectangular halls of plain timber posts with walls of yellow rammed earth and wattle-and-daub, each under one thick, heavy, straight-sloped roof of dry straw thatch; the ridge is a simple rounded bundle of straw lying flat and level, ending flush with the roof edge, with no knobs, no finials, no ornaments, no horns, nothing sticking up; blunt, rounded, untrimmed eaves; roofs low and simple like big haystacks; the settlement is open and unwalled.

items.name: 史官之室
items.prompt: Early Zhou period around 1048 BC, interior of a scribe's small room inside a rammed-earth house, plain yellow earthen walls and timber posts, a low thatched ceiling of straw over wooden beams, lit only by a small clay oil lamp on a low table, bundles of bamboo slips tied with cord stacked against the wall, a writing brush and a flat ink stone on the table beside several small cleaned turtle plastrons, warm intimate light, indoors, no windows showing landscape.

items.name: 姜人牧場
items.prompt: A grassy slope at the foot of a mountain in western China around 1048 BC, flocks of white sheep scattered over it, a few low houses built of stone and earth, a weathered old man sitting in the sun, peaceful pastoral.

items.name: 姜禾
items.prompt: An 18-year-old herder girl of the Jiang clan in ancient western China, sun-browned face, bright direct eyes, long black hair braided with a woolen cord, a short sheepskin coat over plain clothes, a horn bow and a quiver on her back, confident half smile.

items.name: 史鳶
items.prompt: A young scribe of the early Zhou dynasty around 20 years old, earnest thoughtful face, hair bound in a simple topknot with a wooden pin, plain undyed robe, holding a bundle of bamboo slips and a writing brush.

items.name: 伯磬
items.prompt: A young court musician who fled the Shang capital, gentle tired eyes, hair loosely tied, simple robe dusty from travel, holding a small wooden mallet, a set of thin stone chimes hanging on a wooden frame beside him.

items.name: 塬風
items.prompt: A swirling column of yellow loess dust and wind shaped like a running figure, sand grains streaming eastward, earthy ochre tones.

items.name: 狼影
items.prompt: A lean grey wolf made of ink shadow and dust, low to the ground, glowing green eyes, fur dissolving into smoke at the edges.

items.name: 殘車魂
items.prompt: A ghostly overturned ancient Chinese bronze-age war chariot, its spoked wheel still spinning, broken shafts and fluttering tattered banner, bronze fittings with green rust, no horses.

items.name: 無名塚
items.prompt: A small unmarked burial mound of yellow earth come alive, faint pale outlines of two young figures inside like fading ink, a few blank bones scattered, sorrowful rather than scary.

items.name: 失土之魂
items.prompt: A towering figure made entirely of drifting loess earth and dust under moonlight, inside it many faint silhouettes of people wearing different clothes reaching out in different directions, longing for home, melancholic and vast.

items.name: 周原甲骨
items.prompt: Early Zhou period around 1048 BC, inside a dim earthen-walled room, close-up of a young woman and a young scribe bending over a low table under the light of a small clay oil lamp; the young woman holds between her thumb and forefinger a tiny fragment of turtle shell no bigger than a coin, a small pale bony chip, and on it are extremely small carved marks like ant footprints; she squints at it in amazement, bundles of bamboo slips around, plain earthen walls behind them. No paper, no sheets, no scrolls.

items.name: 磬聲
items.prompt: Dawn on the loess plateau, ancient China around 1048 BC, a young musician kneels before a wooden frame of hanging stone chimes, striking one stone with a slim wooden mallet; a herder girl with a bow on her back hums beside him; a young man and a translucent ink-haired young woman listen; golden light over gullies. The stone chimes (qing) are three flat slabs of grey stone of different sizes, each shaped like an upside-down shallow V, a carpenter's square opened to a wide angle: the top edge bends at one corner into two straight slopes like a low roof, the bottom edge is gently curved, the hanging hole is at the top corner of the bend, each hung by a cord from a single plain wooden crossbar. Sharp angular silhouettes, not rounded, not bell-shaped, no bronze. The musician's mallet is a slim wooden stick with a small round knob at its end, like a drumstick, not a hammer.

items.name: 孟津
items.prompt: The Yellow River near Mengjin ferry in ancient China around 1047 BC: an extremely wide, fast, opaque ochre-yellow river carrying silt, low muddy banks. On the south bank, a sprawling military camp of many small tents made of hides and woven mats, dozens of different banners on tall poles flapping in the wind, crowds of people in varied clothing, a larger decorated wooden boat moored at the ferry landing, open-air campfires with smoke rising from the ground. Boats are simple ancient wooden plank boats and dugout canoes, low and narrow, rowed with long wooden oars, no sails, no cabins, no dragon heads.

items.name: 羌人營地
items.prompt: A camp of western highland herders on a riverbank in ancient China around 1047 BC: low round tents of grey-brown felted sheep wool, wooden staffs planted in front with curved goat horns tied at the top, a campfire burning on the ground, people with braided hair wearing sheepskin, distant snowy mountains on the western horizon, dusk light.

items.name: 夜渡黃河
items.prompt: The Yellow River near Mengjin ferry in ancient China around 1047 BC: an extremely wide, fast, opaque ochre-yellow river carrying silt, low muddy banks. Moonless night on the river: three small wooden boats with dark silhouettes of people crouching and rowing, black water with faint ochre gleam, the far bank invisible except for a tiny dim red glow of a distant campfire, almost everything in deep darkness, tense and silent. Boats are simple ancient wooden plank boats and dugout canoes, low and narrow, rowed with long wooden oars, no sails, no cabins, no dragon heads.

items.name: 嶺
items.prompt: A tall middle-aged man from the western highlands, deeply sun-darkened rugged face with deep wrinkles at the eyes, long black hair in several thick braids, a heavy sheepskin coat with the wool turned inward, a leather pouch at his belt, stern but kind eyes.

items.name: 濁浪
items.prompt: A rearing wave of thick ochre-yellow river water full of silt, curling like a grasping hand, brown foam at its crest, heavy and cold.

items.name: 渡口泥鬼
items.prompt: A slumped humanoid figure of wet river mud from a ferry landing, many footprints pressed into its body, broken oars sticking out of its back, dripping brown mud.

items.name: 沉舟魂
items.prompt: The ghost of a capsized ancient wooden plank boat rising from the water, upside down, waterlogged dark planks, trailing ropes and reeds like limbs, pale glow inside the hull.

items.name: 白魚兆
items.prompt: A huge glowing white fish leaping and floating in the air, scales shining blinding white with rainbow sheen, wide open mouth, surrounded by faint swirling crowds of tiny cheering silhouettes, both beautiful and ominous.

items.name: 濁河之怒
items.prompt: An enormous towering wall of muddy ochre-yellow river water taller than boats, churning with silt and debris, shaped like a vast angry face without features, dark sky, terrifying force of nature, not a god, no human figure, no dragon.

items.name: 夜渡
items.prompt: The Yellow River near Mengjin ferry in ancient China around 1047 BC: an extremely wide, fast, opaque ochre-yellow river carrying silt, low muddy banks. Night on a small crowded wooden boat in the middle of the river: a thin teenage boy in a worn sheepskin vest leans over the side, seasick, yet laughing weakly, a young man beside him steadies his shoulder, a translucent young woman with long ink-black hair that dissolves like ink in water looks at the boy with deep recognition, other people huddled, dim moonless darkness with only a faint red glow from a distant fire. Boats are simple ancient wooden plank boats and dugout canoes, low and narrow, rowed with long wooden oars, no sails, no cabins, no dragon heads.
